A short password will also be withheld from command output and will refuse commands whose text contains it (SECRET_IN_COMMAND), so a longer password avoids unexpected refusals. No minimum length is enforced.

Keys, passphrases and passwords are never displayed. Replacements require every secret again; blank fields do not retain stored values.
